in_marathi.name: Bhawani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of power and strength
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhawani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhawani is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Goddess of power and strength'. She is revered in Hindu mythology as a manifestation of Shakti, the divine mother, and is often depicted with multiple arms, holding various weapons and symbols, representing her various aspects and powers. Bhawani is a revered deity in various regions of India and is especially worshipped in Nepal, where she is known as Bhagwati and is considered the protector of the nation.
